selection_basis: Lowest exploratory source-family macro NLL cycle5; no new-source scores inspected.
evaluation: Teacher-forced event NLL and exact pitch/duration counts per work, equal work mean per family; no attractiveness conclusion. Report all controls and failures; no retuning on fresh set.
admission: Only fully rights-reviewed exact sources, family-grouped, strict reader accepted and duplicate screened before scoring. Candidate metadata may be inspected; no model scoring before freeze.
after_evaluation: Mark sources observed and never call them fresh again. No training reassignment without new explicit exploratory ledger.
